principles.sp500_sentiment: renormalized cap-weighted mean across observed constituents only
principles.sp500_price: true index source such as ^GSPC, never SPY as index-level substitute
principles.universe_boundary: Broad U.S. company coverage is separate from S&P 500 weighting, attribution, portfolio and research contracts
principles.transcript_policy: free public transcript text may be analyzed transiently; public artifacts retain derived metrics and source URLs, not third-party transcript body text

resources.description: S&P Composite 1500 plus broader U.S. company metadata and latest market fields
Retained deduplicated company news with article sentiment where scored
Extended daily price history with observed sentiment and sentiment_observed flags
resources.missing_semantics: sentiment is missing on no-news days; do not convert missing to zero

resources.description: Per-company and universe-wide news/history fulfillment coverage
EPS history, structured free-public call diagnostics when available, source links and filing evidence
Complete, partial, link-only and missing structured-call coverage across the company universe
Persistent company/theme event instances clustered from retained article evidence
Observed sentiment series for S&P 500, MidCap 400, SmallCap 600, Composite 1500 and broad U.S. equity coverage
S&P 500 daily close, aggregate observed sentiment and coverage
Constituent metadata, weight, price reaction and latest observed sentiment
Symbols with original S&P-core ticker snapshots
Core S&P price/sentiment history plus scored recent articles
resources.missing_semantics: Use sentiment_observed / n_total when present. Carried-forward display S is not a new observation.

natural_language_interface.behavior: Natural language maps to explicit filters and rankings over published core fields.

research_lab.inference: Newey-West/Bartlett HAC for mean daily high-minus-low spread; lag = horizon - 1
research_lab.specification_id: stable hash of selected research specification
